title: This Planet Is 7,800 Degrees, Hotter Than Most Stars

scenes.text: There's a planet hotter than most stars.
It's called KELT-9b, and its daytime side hits about 7,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
That's hot enough to tear water and metals apart into glowing gas.
It orbits so close that its whole year lasts only one and a half Earth days.
Its star is blasting it, and may slowly be evaporating the planet away.
A planet that's hotter than most stars. Check the first line again.

description:
KELT-9b is a gas giant whose daytime side reaches about 7,800 degrees Fahrenheit, hotter than most stars.
It circles its star every 1.5 days and the star's radiation may be evaporating it.
Would you want to see a planet that hot up close?

first_comment: Bonus: its year lasts only 1.5 Earth days. Would you rather live on the hottest planet or the coldest?
